question: Was this game decided by luck or by my choices?
answer: The game was decided mostly by luck. You got two big misses with Hurricane and Leaf Storm, Fezandipiti got frozen and then crit by Ice Beam, and you lost Kyurem and Great Tusk to back-to-back crits while you got a crit Flip Turn and a crit Earth Power on your side. Your switches into Landorus and Samurott were also punishing, but the sequence of misses, freeze and crits swung win chance far more than the decisions.
